notes.title: Alpha build 0.5 is out
notes.content:
[list]
[*] It is now possible to throw the yellow ball directly to your opponents, stunning in one hit all their undead
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added balls score and multiplier visualization, this should help understanding how to hit the orbs to maximize your score.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added sounds when you hit the undead and stun or possess them. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added more variety to orbs dimension. The bigger the ball the harder you have to slap to pop it.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Bugs fixing and optimization.
[/list]

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/yeBqeUm ]Discord[/url] to keep updated with the latest developments and help testing the game before release. Musician? We welcome you.

notes.title: Alpha build 0.3 is out
notes.content:
- Added Advanced Tips at the end of the tutorial
- Added the ability to switch between Dark and Light mode in the main menu
- Added the duration of the song in the songs selection
- Added the title of the song you just played in the Score panel.
- Songs name and score text now resize when they get longer
- Fixed the restart song problems
- Fixed the Quit button problems
- Fixed the Pause problems
- Disabled the joystick turning
- Opponents’ skills have been balanced and ball throwing has been improved.
- A lot of minor bugs fixing

Thanks all for the precious feedback. We fixed a lot of the bugs you found and already implemented some of your suggestions. 

If you want to try the demo before the Festival and help with debugging, join our [url=https://discord.gg/yeBqeUm ]Discord[/url]
